items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: You know, I was at Leon's and Eddie's too on 52nd Street.

ctx.x: You know, I was at Leon's and Eddie's too on 52nd Street.
I never knew Leon and Eddie's had any jazz in there to begin with.
Leon and Eddie--I was at Leon and Eddie's before I went into the Famous Door.
